Task: Federated Login Flow

Write Python code that fetches and normalizes federated user profile claims using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
import os
import requests
from typing import Dict, Any

AUTH0_DOMAIN = os.getenv("AUTH0_DOMAIN", "my-tenant.auth0.com")
AUTH0_USERINFO_URL = f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/userinfo"

def fetch_and_normalize_federated_claims(access_token: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {access_token}",
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
    }
    response = requests.get(AUTH0_USERINFO_URL, headers=headers, timeout=10)
    response.raise_for_status()
    raw_claims = response.json()
    
    identities = raw_claims.get("identities", [])
    federated_provider = (
        identities[0].get("provider") 
        if identities 
        else raw_claims.get("iss", "").rstrip("/").split("/")[-1] or "auth0"
    )
    
    return {
        "federated_sub": raw_claims.get("sub"),
        "email": raw_claims.get("email"),
        "email_verified": bool(raw_claims.get("email_verified")),
        "display_name": raw_claims.get("name") or raw_claims.get("nickname"),
        "given_name": raw_claims.get("given_name"),
        "family_name": raw_claims.get("family_name"),
        "avatar_url": raw_claims.get("picture"),
        "federated_provider": federated_provider
    }
